title: Marsail Ergonomic Office Chair: Office Computer Desk Chair with High Back Mesh and Adjustable Lumbar Support Rolling Work Swivel Task Chairs with Wheel 3D Armrests and Headrest (White)
reviews: Oh man, finally put mine together (8 months after buying it!) WELL worth the price. Between work and studying for bar exam, I'm at my computer 10-12-14 hours a day. And I'm a heavy guy - 270-280. This thing is nice. Ample seat, good padding, feels like sitting on air. Easy and fast to put together - just 7 steps. I love the ability to raise the arms so I can play guitar in it. The mesh is so much better than feaux leather in the Texas heat. And I like the ability to adjust the lumbar, because my lumbar isn't in an S shape. Finally, yes, the frame is plastic, but it feels sturdy! It's hard plastic and lots of it.

Purchased this chair for my son who does a lot of gaming. He loves it. Took about 30 mins to assemble. Instructions are very easy to follow. Pros - very easy to put together - very comfy back rest with arch adjustment - can recline - can adjust height - very stable - material is very sturdy - wheels moved smoothly over carpet - material is strong - solid black color Cons - limited adjustments with recline

I am 20 years old and a college student, I have horrible posture, and I game a lot, so my chair is VERY important to me. This chair was decently okay to assemble, and the initial sitting experience is good. You can feel yourself sink into the seat but not too much which is really nice. The arm rests are tiltable which is AMAZING because I always have a weird stance when I sit so this is perfect for me. However, there is one thing about this chair that is CRITICAL to know before buying. Perhaps this is my own fault, but the back isn't adjustable. What I mean by that is that you can't lean the back of the chair forward, kind of like how you can in a car seat. There is a pillow that you can push further into the back rest with a nob on the back but that barely helps. The headrest is also abysmal because I have to lean so far back into the chair just for my head to hit the head rest. I want a headrest that is always against my head. Not something that I have to tilt my head back into just for my head to hit it. That makes the chair extremely uncomfortable if I am trying to use the headrest. The chair also feels wobbly, I have had previous chairs where over time the gas lift wears out over time and when I sit on the chair the chair falls to the ground because the gas lift doesn't work anymore. However, that takes years of wear and tear. Sitting in this chair makes me feel like it is going to happen way sooner. Also, the picture makes it look way whiter than it is in real life. It is kind of like a white that is getting to a pee color and it is kind of gross looking a little bit but it isn't that bad since it isn't fully that color. Another thing is that crumbs actually get stuck in the tiny holes in the seat cushion so you can't swipe it off your chair they are literally inside of it. I will leave a better review once I had used it for a while. If you are just looking for a nice chair and don't really care to much about the specifics it isn't a bad choice.

Very easy to assemble, comfortable, sleek design, and the colours are just as pictured. I can't speak on durability as I just got it. The back support works well. Something I loved is that the head and arms support adjust to your needs.

I recently purchased the Marsail Ergonomic Office Chair, and overall, I couldn’t be happier with it. First off, assembly was incredibly simple. It took me about 30 minutes from start to finish, and the instructions were clear and easy to follow. All the parts were well packaged, and I didn’t run into any issues putting it together. For reference, I’m 6'2" and about 275 pounds, and this chair fits me very well. As a bigger guy, finding a chair that feels supportive and appropriately sized can be a challenge, but this one hits the mark. The seat is roomy without feeling oversized, and the overall build feels sturdy and solid. Comfort-wise, it’s been excellent. I work from home and spend about 8–9 hours a day in this chair, five days a week. The thick cushion seat really makes a difference, it stays comfortable throughout the day and doesn’t feel like it’s flattening out after hours of use. I also really like the mesh back. It provides good support while allowing airflow, which helps keep me cool during long work sessions. The only feature I wish it had is a recline lock at multiple angles. Currently, it only locks in the fully upright position. It would be great to be able to lock it slightly reclined for more flexibility during long workdays. That said, for the price, ease of assembly, and all-day comfort, this chair delivers tremendous value. I’m giving the Marsail Ergonomic Office Chair 5 stars and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable, supportive office chair, especially if you’re on the taller or bigger side like me.

So far so good. Chair arrived well packaged and undamaged. Assembly was quick and easy. Components appear to be well-made, not flimsy or fragile. The chair is comfortable and provides multiple adjustments to dial in the feel. I like the mesh back and lumbar support. Time will tell on durability. At approximately 1/10 the cost of a H-M desk chair, I’m willing to give up some features and I can buy a new one in a few years.

I bought 4 chairs for my table. Easy to put together. The arms are too short. They move too much and there is no way to lock the arms in place. The worse thing is the material used to cover the arms. It is sticky. Each chair has the same problem so I took a pair of socks to cover the arms. So, you should offer custom arm covers and a way to lock the arms. For the weight allowed the pneumatic support that holds and adjusts the height of the seat holds me quite well. The wheels stick out beyond the seat circumference so everyday I run into them as I go to sit down but it is a good thing as you can be seated and you are not going to flip over if you bend down from the seat to reach for something on the floor. The seat itself should be able to accommodate a person of a larger size a big man. It is like you made the chair for little people that weigh a lot (narrow seat, short arms, vs. a large wheel span and powerful the pneumatic pump). The neck support requires a pillow. Without the pillow my head and neck do not rest on the mesh. Regarding comfort, I sit in the chair for a lot of time each day. Although it feels a bit hard the seat is fairly comfortable. It would be more comfortable if it were bigger. I purchased these chairs because of the welcoming way the company describes itself, therefore, I hope they will make some changes to improve the chair. I would not buy them if I had the chance again, not without improvements made. I don't need four more chairs, so, I will live with my purchase. If the chairs already had those improvements my opinion would be different. They may be perfect for someone else of a different body type (and age).

This chair is a lifesaver!!! After reviewing multiple economic chairs at different price ranges and settled on this one and it has not disappointed!!! Assembly was easy with just one person. I have multiple herniated discs, my most severe one in my lower back. This chair does not aggravate them at all unlike my previous chairs. I WFH and don’t even realize I’ve sat multiple hours straight without pain or getting up. Worth every penny!!
